_meta.purpose: PROD-017 -- a small, representative directory listing for meeting 86178's real revisions/drafts folder (https://www.3gpp.org/ftp/tsg_sa/WG4_CODEC/3GPP_SA4_AHOC_MTGs/SA4_Plenary/inbox/drafts/), used by tests/revision-drafts-folder.test.js to exercise updateRevisions_()'s draft-discovery/matching logic offline.
_meta.provenance: Unlike meeting-resolver-samples.json's GetMeetings/GetiCal/TdocList.aspx fixtures (byte-for-byte captured responses), this HTML is RECONSTRUCTED -- not literal captured bytes. A live, browser-rendered investigation of the real URL above (during ARCH-011 and again during PROD-017) confirmed the exact filenames listed below actually exist there, including two real, distinct draft files for the same canonical TDoc (S4aP260071_BBC.docx and S4aP260071_QCOM.docx) and other representative files with contributor-tag suffixes. A direct (non-browser) HTTP probe of the same URL from this environment returns HTTP 403 from 3GPP's WAF/bot-challenge (see ARCH-011's own commit message and tests/meeting-revisions-folder.test.js), so raw bytes could not be captured the way the other fixtures were. This file reconstructs an Apache-autoindex-shaped listing containing exactly those real, confirmed filenames -- no filename here was invented.
confirmedRealFiles: S4aP260071_BBC.docx and S4aP260071_QCOM.docx -- two real, distinct draft files for the SAME canonical TDoc S4aP260071, confirming multiple-drafts-per-TDoc is a genuine, observed case for this meeting, not a synthetic scenario.
S4aP260096_stabilization_huawei.docx -- confirmed during ARCH-011's investigation of the same folder.
